evidence_items.explanation: This establishes the original conversational product baseline. It does not measure what most users subsequently valued.

evidence_items.explanation: This challenges the broad description of an unchanged product: users gained new input and interaction modes. It does not establish a material benefit for the majority.

evidence_items.explanation: The accompanying list includes web responses, data analysis, charts, photo discussion and file uploads for free users. These are relevant functionality changes, but availability does not demonstrate their importance to most users.

evidence_items.explanation: This is relevant representative research, but its overall results extend through July 2025. They do not settle whether most users experienced material change by October 2024.
